name: Half-tube hide, brown
label: Hides
lead: Simple brown half-tube hide with a smooth surface, open at both ends - a hygienic shelter that cleans in a moment.

description.html: This hide does not imitate stone or wood. It is a simple light brown half-tube with a completely smooth surface, open at both ends, with small notches on the lower edge. That simplicity is exactly its advantage.

A smooth surface with no pores or patterns washes clean in seconds and does not hold substrate, droppings or bacteria. That makes this hide practical for quarantine, hatchlings, recovering animals and simple breeder setups, where hygiene matters more than looks.
The tunnel shape suits snakes and lizards that like to squeeze through and rest in a narrow space, and the two openings let them exit on either side.

If you need a darker hide, place one end of the tunnel against the glass or a rock. In a natural-looking terrarium you can partly cover the half-tube with substrate, bark or moss so it is barely visible. Wash it with warm water whenever you clean the terrarium.
